title: Jacquard thread
description: Cobalt and unbleached threads cross in a visible twill with a burnt-orange stripe.
useCase: Control the width and construction of a woven material at thread scale.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Analytic crossing shadows and thread profiles; no cloth physics or measured fibre-scattering model.
look: Full-bleed tilted twill weave of cobalt warp and unbleached cream weft threads, with evenly spaced burnt-orange warp stripes and fine fibre ridges.
motion: The weave is static apart from a faint sheen on each thread that brightens and dims on a roughly 31-second sine; the thread-width slider thickens or thins threads.
adapt: The weave is all in `main` of `FRAGMENT`: `rot(-.16)` and `29.` set angle and density, `over` sets the twill step, `selvedge` places the orange stripes and `lamp` drives the sheen. `controlRef` feeds `u_control` (thread `width`); recolour `warp`, `weft` and `col`.
